overview:
Imagine waking up to misty hills, lush green valleys, beautiful waterfalls, and peaceful villages. That is the magic of Meghalaya.

Known as the “Abode of Clouds,” Meghalaya is perfect for travelers who love nature, adventure, culture, and scenic road trips. A well-planned Meghalaya Tour Package makes your journey easier by taking care of accommodation, transportation, sightseeing, and other important travel arrangements.

Whether you are traveling with family, your partner, or friends, Meghalaya offers experiences you will remember for years. From the vibrant pine hills of Shillong to the dramatic waterfalls of Cherrapunji, peaceful villages of Mawlynnong, and the crystal-clear waters of Dawki, every destination offers something unique.

importantTravelInfo: Road travel is an essential part of exploring Meghalaya. Keep some flexibility in your schedule because journeys through hilly areas can take longer than expected.
Weather can change quickly, especially during the rainy season. Check the weather forecast, confirm road conditions, keep rain protection handy, and allow extra travel time.
Reaching living root bridges requires walking down stone steps; comfortable walking shoes and adequate hydration are important.

Responsible tourism: Help protect Meghalaya's natural beauty by avoiding littering, respecting local customs, following local guidelines, avoiding damage to natural attractions, and supporting local businesses.
Airport transfer planning: Guwahati serves as the primary arrival gateway; coordinate your flight or train schedule with the 3 to 4-hour scenic road journey to Shillong.

itinerary.title: Guwahati to Shillong | Arrival, Umiam Lake & Shillong Check-in
itinerary.description: Arrive at Guwahati Airport/Railway Station, where you will be warmly welcomed by a Safar Trails representative. Begin your scenic journey towards Shillong, the beautiful capital of Meghalaya. En-route visit Umiam Lake and enjoy panoramic views of the surrounding hills. Continue the picturesque drive towards Shillong. On arrival, check in to your hotel. Evening at leisure to explore the local market and Police Bazaar. Overnight stay in Shillong.
itinerary.morningActivity: Warm welcome by Safar Trails representative at Guwahati Airport or Railway Station
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Scenic hill drive with an en-route stop at panoramic Umiam Lake (Barapani)
itinerary.eveningActivity: Check-in at your Shillong hotel and leisure stroll through Police Bazaar
itinerary.insiderTip: Stop by the Umiam Lake viewpoint for tea, fresh pineapples, and stunning photographs of the reservoir.

itinerary.title: Shillong Local Sightseeing | Viewpoints, Waterfalls & Culture
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for a full-day exploration of Shillong. Visit Shillong Peak for panoramic views of the city (subject to weather and local access), followed by Elephant Falls, one of Shillong’s most popular and scenic waterfalls. Take a peaceful walk around Ward’s Lake, visit the prominent Cathedral of Mary Help of Christians, and enjoy leisure time in Police Bazaar for shopping and experiencing local food. Return to the hotel after sightseeing. Overnight stay in Shillong.
itinerary.morningActivity: Visit Shillong Peak and the multi-tiered cascades of Elephant Falls
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Peaceful walk around Ward’s Lake and visit Cathedral of Mary Help of Christians
itinerary.eveningActivity: Leisure shopping for local handicrafts, woolens, and café hopping around Police Bazaar
itinerary.insiderTip: Ward's Lake features charming wooden footbridges and feeding points for friendly ducks and carp.

itinerary.title: Shillong to Cherrapunji | Canyons, Caves & Soaring Waterfalls
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and proceed towards Cherrapunji, one of Meghalaya’s most scenic destinations. En route, stop at Mawkdok Dympep Valley Viewpoint for breathtaking valley views and continue through picturesque landscapes. Visit Nohkalikai Falls (subject to weather and visibility), explore Mawsmai Cave and its fascinating limestone formations, and visit Seven Sisters Falls (subject to seasonal water flow). Later, check in to your hotel/resort and relax. Overnight stay in Cherrapunji.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breathtaking views at Mawkdok Dympep Valley Viewpoint and drive to Sohra
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Explore awe-inspiring Nohkalikai Falls and walk through limestone passages at Mawsmai Cave
itinerary.eveningActivity: View Seven Sisters Falls and check in to your scenic Cherrapunji resort
itinerary.insiderTip: Carry a light windbreaker or raincoat, as Cherrapunji's mountain ridges often welcome sudden misty clouds and showers.

itinerary.title: Cherrapunji to Dawki & Mawlynnong to Shillong | River & Village
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed towards Dawki through the scenic landscapes of Meghalaya. Visit Dawki and the famous Umngot River, renowned for its clear waters (subject to weather and river conditions). Optional boating and river activities may be arranged at an additional cost. Continue towards Mawlynnong, known for its picturesque village surroundings, explore the village pathways, and visit the Mawlynnong Sky View Bamboo Watchtower (subject to local access). Later, proceed towards Shillong, check in to the hotel, and relax. Overnight stay in Shillong.
itinerary.morningActivity: Drive to Dawki and admire the transparent emerald waters of the Umngot River
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Explore clean pathways of Mawlynnong Village and climb the Bamboo Sky Watchtower
itinerary.eveningActivity: Scenic return drive to Shillong, hotel check-in, and relaxing evening
itinerary.insiderTip: During the drier winter and spring months, the Umngot River is so clear that country boats appear to float in mid-air.

itinerary.title: Shillong | Living Root Bridge & Local Experience
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for a memorable nature and local experience excursion. Visit a traditional Living Root Bridge (subject to route, weather, and local conditions), enjoy a scenic walk through the lush surroundings of Meghalaya, and experience the natural beauty of forests, streams, and traditional village landscapes. Return to Shillong by evening, with free time for shopping, café hopping, or exploring the city. Overnight stay in Shillong.
itinerary.morningActivity: Excursion to a traditional bio-engineered Living Root Bridge and forested trails
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Nature walk alongside crystal mountain streams and traditional village communities
itinerary.eveningActivity: Return to Shillong for leisure time, live music cafés, and café hopping
itinerary.insiderTip: Wear comfortable walking shoes with good grip for the stone pathways leading to the living root bridges.

itinerary.title: Shillong to Guwahati | Kamakhya Temple & Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and proceed towards Guwahati. Depending on your departure schedule, visit the sacred Kamakhya Temple (subject to temple timings and local conditions). Later, proceed to Guwahati Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey. Tour ends with beautiful memories of Meghalaya!
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast, hotel check-out, and scenic downhill drive towards Guwahati
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Visit the sacred Kamakhya Temple on Nilachal Hill (timing permitting)
itinerary.eveningActivity: Drop-off at Guwahati Airport (GAU) or Railway Station for onward journey
itinerary.insiderTip: Allow ample buffer time for the 3 to 4-hour highway drive from Shillong to Guwahati Airport.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Shillong
topPlacesToVisit.description: Often the starting point for Meghalaya trips, Shillong is a great introduction to the state's culture and natural beauty with local markets, scenic viewpoints, cafés, local food, and nearby waterfalls.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Cherrapunji (Sohra)
topPlacesToVisit.description: Locally known as Sohra, Cherrapunji is famous for dramatic landscapes, Nohkalikai Falls, Mawsmai Cave, Seven Sisters Falls, living root bridges, and beautiful valley views.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Dawki & Umngot River
topPlacesToVisit.description: Famous for the crystal-clear Umngot River where visitors can enjoy boat rides, admire transparent waters, take scenic photographs, and relax beside the river along the Indo-Bangladesh border.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Mawlynnong Village
topPlacesToVisit.description: Known for its peaceful village atmosphere, clean paved lanes, lush greenery, nature walks, warm local hospitality, and the Bamboo Sky Watchtower overlooking the plains.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Nongriat & Double Decker Root Bridge
topPlacesToVisit.description: Especially popular with adventure lovers, Nongriat is home to the famous Double Decker Living Root Bridge reached via an invigorating trek through dense rainforest.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Mawsynram
topPlacesToVisit.description: Known globally for heavy rainfall, vibrant green landscapes, peaceful surroundings, natural beauty, and scenic village areas beyond the usual tourist circuit.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Jowai
topPlacesToVisit.description: A wonderful destination for travelers looking for beautiful natural surroundings, waterfalls, placid lakes, rolling green hills, and quieter attractions suitable for longer itineraries.

bestTimeToVisit.season: Summer (April to June) – Sightseeing & Hill Drives
bestTimeToVisit.description: Summer can be a comfortable time for sightseeing, scenic road trips, nature walks, and exploring waterfalls and viewpoints away from the heat of the plains.

bestTimeToVisit.season: Monsoon (July to September) – Cascading Waterfalls & Lush Hills
bestTimeToVisit.description: Monsoon brings Meghalaya's landscapes to life with lush greenery, fuller roaring waterfalls, misty hills, and dramatic scenery. Heavy rain can affect road conditions, so flexibility in travel plans is important.

bestTimeToVisit.season: Autumn (October to November) – Pleasant Outdoor Exploration
bestTimeToVisit.description: Autumn offers pleasant conditions for sightseeing and exploring the outdoors. It is a great option for travelers who want a balance between vibrant greenery and comfortable travel.

bestTimeToVisit.season: Winter (December to March) – Crisp Weather & Clear Rivers
bestTimeToVisit.description: Winter brings cooler weather, clear blue skies, and optimal conditions for sightseeing, photography, exploring markets, scenic drives, relaxing outdoors, and crystal-clear river waters at Dawki.

faqs.question: How many days are enough for a Meghalaya trip?
faqs.answer: Around 5 to 7 days can give you enough time to explore several major destinations at a comfortable pace, including Shillong, Cherrapunji, Dawki, Mawlynnong, and Living Root Bridges. Shorter trips are also possible if you have limited time.

faqs.question: What is the best month to visit Meghalaya?
faqs.answer: The ideal month depends on your preferences. For lush greenery and roaring waterfalls, consider the rainy season (July to September). For cooler weather and crystal-clear waters at Dawki, consider winter (December to February). For comfortable outdoor exploration and balanced greenery, autumn (October to November) and summer (April to June) are excellent.

faqs.question: How much does a Meghalaya Tour Package cost?
faqs.answer: The price depends on the trip duration, number of travelers, hotel category (3-star, 4-star, or premium resort), transportation type, travel season, meal plans, and additional activities. Safar Trails offers transparent, customizable packages to match your preferences and budget.

faqs.question: Which places should I visit in Meghalaya?
faqs.answer: Popular destinations include Shillong (capital with viewpoints and markets), Cherrapunji/Sohra (waterfalls, caves, and canyons), Dawki (crystal-clear Umngot River), Mawlynnong (peaceful village and bamboo watchtower), Nongriat (Double Decker Living Root Bridge), Mawsynram (green village landscapes), and Jowai (serene waterfalls and lakes).

faqs.question: Is Meghalaya suitable for a family trip?
faqs.answer: Yes. Families can enjoy scenic drives, waterfalls, viewpoints, peaceful villages, and rich cultural experiences. The itinerary can be adjusted according to the ages and comfort levels of family members, ensuring relaxed travel and comfortable hotel stays.

faqs.question: Is Meghalaya good for a honeymoon?
faqs.answer: Meghalaya can be an appealing choice for couples who enjoy nature, scenic hill drives, peaceful surroundings, cascading waterfalls, unique experiences, and photography. The misty weather and romantic boutique resorts make it a memorable getaway.

faqs.question: How can I book a Meghalaya Tour Package with Safar Trails?
faqs.answer: Start by selecting your travel dates and preferred destinations. Then choose the number of days, compare package inclusions, select your preferred accommodation, customize the itinerary if needed, and confirm the booking with Safar Trails.

faqs.question: What should I pack for a Meghalaya trip?
faqs.answer: Carry comfortable walking shoes with good grip, lightweight clothing, rain protection (umbrella or raincoat), a small day backpack, personal medicines, a reusable water bottle, and a power bank. If visiting in winter, pack light to medium woolens.

faqs.question: Can I book a Meghalaya tour package from major cities like Delhi, Kolkata, Mumbai, or Bangalore?
faqs.answer: Yes. Travelers from all major Indian cities can easily plan a Meghalaya holiday. Guwahati (GAU) serves as the primary arrival airport and railway hub with direct flights and trains, where your private Safar Trails cab and driver will receive you.
